title: Ukukgholophala akwenzi umuntu ukobana angakghoni ukwenza izinto
author: African Storybook
content:
Lona nguAgnes,
ungutitjhere.

uAgnes ukgholophele,
ukhamba aberegisa
iingodo zokukhamba.

Lona nguMetobo,
uberega ukudlala
iingoma emrhatjhweni.

uMetobo likawu,
usogoliswa mamehlo.

Lona nguMora,
ungumlimi.

uMora akezwa
eendlebeni, ukhuluma
aberegisa izandla.

Lona nguOsero,
ungumdlali omkhulu
waka
makhakhulararhwe
esikolweni.

uOsero wathola ingozi,
yamrholophalisa izandla
zakhe, kodwa
uyaphumelela
emdlalweni
ngokuberegisa iinyawo
zakhe.
